scripts.reports: wrangler d1 execute blank --remote --command "SELECT e.id, e.course, e.term, e.assessment, e.assessment_number, r.reason, COUNT(*) AS reports, MAX(r.created_at) AS latest FROM exam_reports r JOIN exam_bank e ON e.id = r.exam_id GROUP BY e.id, r.reason ORDER BY latest DESC LIMIT 50"
